scripts.comment: GSAP / Navbar menu and Studio Statement / Office clocks tick: live analog clocks in the menu and on Studio Statement. Each clock row carries its time zone in a data-clock-tz attribute, such as Europe/London. GSAP turns the hour, minute and second hands and writes the time into the element marked data-clock-time (or .office-text_time). Remove this block to drop the clocks; the dials then show their resting position.

GSAP / Navbar menu / Link hover focus: pointing at or tabbing to one of the main menu links dims the others to 50% and turns that link to the accent colour, with a small nudge to the right. The accent is read from the menu's Accent Primary variable, so a new brand colour carries over. Remove this block to keep the links static.

GSAP / Global / Counters count up on scroll: figures count up from zero the first time they scroll into view, using GSAP and ScrollTrigger. It picks up the studio figures, the Statement ledger, case study results and metrics, and any element you give a data-count attribute. The text stays as typed in the Designer or the CMS, such as 2,100 or 9 days; the script counts the number inside it and keeps the words around it. Remove this block and the figures simply show as typed.
